notes.title: Voidside 1.8.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey! The staggering amount of new Voidside players recently has led to this hotfix, which addresses a key issue and also adds a few visual/audio improvements here and there!

[list]
[*] All weapon models now better fit Voidside's theme.
[*] Paladin abilities now have audio!
[*] Added a new default, 'Auto' resolution option which sets the game's resolution to that of the monitor that it is being displayed onto. Custom resolutions can still be chosen.
[*] Changed player glove material.
[/list]

That's all for this one, but keep leaving feedback! I'm incredibly grateful for the attention that Voidside has gotten recently, and I hope you all have a load of fun with this update!

Spacepiano :D

notes.title: Voidside 1.8.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Before I start the patch notes, I just want to announce that Voidside has been nominated for a BAFTA YGD award! I want to thank everyone who has left feedback on the game, without you Voidside wouldn't be half the game it is today :) Now, without further ado, here are the patch notes!

[list]
[*] Improved Health & Coin pickup visuals.
[*] Improved Health & Coin pickup audio.
[*] Health & Coin pickups are now GPU instanced.
[*] Normal Enemy variants no longer have a 'Galaxy' effect applied to them, and are now GPU instanced.
[*] Higher graphics settings no longer force textures to render at full resolution if required.
[*] Main Menu visuals have been altered to feature Voidside's new logo.
[/list]

Thanks so much for playing, sorry for the amount of technical jargon in these patch notes, and I hope you continue to have fun!

Spacepiano :D

notes.title: Voidside: Intermission | UPDATE OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[h1]Introducing Intermission![/h1]
Voidside: Intermission is out now! This is a smaller update designed to provide extra content to enjoy until the next one releases. It reworks a map, and adds a new feature to the game.

[h2]Trailer[/h2]
[previewyoutube=89o04bhFk2E;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]A whole new world![/h3]
Labs has been refreshed with extra detail and 2 new jump pads; a feature arriving this update. Shoot your way through the hordes in an even more threatening environment than before!

[h3]Boing![/h3]
Jump pads are a new addition that have landed not only in labs, but also in a number of old maps! These are prefect for a quick getaway, hopefully leading to less situations in which the player is completely hopeless.

[h3]Looking ahead[/h3]
As stated earlier, this is a smaller update that lays a lot of groundwork for very exciting things to come, so stay tuned!

As always I hope you enjoy the update!
Spacepiano :D

[h3]Full patch notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked Map: Labs
[*] Added Jump Pads to: Construction, Citadel, Complex, Labs & Mars
[*] Updated the main menu to support Voidside's next major update
[*] Added files to support Voidside's next major update
[*] Fixed a bug in which the player would collide with enemy weapons
[/list]

notes.title: Voidside 1.1.1 - The Quality of Life update
notes.notes:
This update reworks/fixes a few common issues with the game.
- Construction has been reworked to allow for more fluid movement
- Sliding is now faster
- The shotgun now deals more damage in a wider radius
- A farming spot in labs has been removed
- Dashing is now bound to LSHIFT
- Dashing is now in the direction of wherever the player is looking
- The double jump is now omnidirectional
- Framework for a keybinds system has been put in place (to be finished at a later date)
- Begun work on the next major content update, 'Remix'
- Added 3 new achievements

I hope you're having fun!
- Spacepiano :D

notes.title: Announcing Voidside's next update! ... Wait what??
notes.notes:
You read that right. Voidside's getting an update! Only problem is: The game isn't out yet!

I wanted to make this announcement now as I want to set expectations for how Voidside is going to be handled post-launch. Voidside is NOT an early access game, the game as it is can be played over and over again and players will receive the intended experience.

However, that does not mean that the game will be abandoned on arrival. I plan on updating this game over the course of time, not regularly, but whenever I personally feel like there is something I could add to Voidside outside the game's current scope. This is my way of making sure that Voidside's release doesn't get delayed over and over again.

Now, I bet you're wondering: When will this update come out? What does it include? Should I hold off until the update comes out?

I currently do not know when the update will come out, as I do not want to pressure myself with any unneeded deadlines. I can't go into specifics about the update itself, but I can share the title: 'Monsters an Machine Guns'. And lastly, If you want to get the game this update will not significantly change core gameplay or delete progress, so hop in as soon as the game launches!

This update will be free to all Voidside players, past, present and future.

Until then I hope you're looking forward to Voidside's release on the 16th, and if you're reading this in the future then I hope that you're having fun!

Spacepiano ;D

notes.title: Closed Beta | Upcoming Balance Changes!
notes.notes:
Hi to all who currently have access to the closed beta (and all future members too!)

I'd like to note down some upcoming balance changes, expected to be pushed today or tomorrow. Leave  your thoughts in the replies if you want to share your thoughts.

First off, with a (somewhat) heavy heart, I've made the decision to remove melee attacks from the game. They will only ever be ridiculously strong or ridiculously weak, and let's face it - neither of those are fun. (Don't worry, I will be adding a VERY powerful endgame weapon to the game soon.)

On a more positive note however, I'd like to announce that 3 weapons are getting buffed - the shotgun, the rifle, and the burst rifle. They have all been modified to provide a 1-hit kill, as long as your aim is steady. 

For the shotgun, this means that it fires 3 pellets, and each does 40 damage (the typical enemy has 100HP).

For the rifle, one shot now equals one kill, and the fire rate has been greatly increased!

And finally for the burst, each bullet now does 50 damage.

I'm still looking into more ways of balancing the game, such as altering run speed, enemy damage (& amount) and additional weapon tweaks. Something to remember is that this game takes inspiration from vampire survivors in the sense that massive hordes of enemies are displayed at a time. The out-of-game progression system is pretty solid right now, but I'm struggling to think of ways I could allow per-game progression to feel more satisfying without breaking the flow of the game. Again, tell me in the replies if you have any ideas.

Edit: The closed beta is currently only available to people I know and have given special access, I plan on widening this scope soon.

That's all for now, have a great day!
- Spacepiano
